parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Client token used to ensure idempotence of the request. Generate a unique parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken only supports ASCII characters. Note: If you do not specify this, the system will automatically use the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken identifier. The RequestId is different for each API request.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: Page size, with a range of **1** to **50**. Default value: **50**.

parameters.name: MemberId
parameters.description:
Route target group member instance ID.
Filters the route target groups that contain the specified member instance ID.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: Token for the next query. Value: If it is the first query or there is no next query, this field does not need to be filled. If there is a next query, the value should be the NextToken returned from the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the VPC to which the route target group belongs. You can obtain the region ID by calling the DescribeRegions interface.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: Resource group ID. For more information about resource groups, see What is a Resource Group?

parameters.name: RouteTargetGroupIds
parameters.description:
List of route target group instance IDs.

Up to 50 instance IDs can be queried at a time.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC to which the route target group belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc list-route-target-groups --vpc-id vpc-xxxx --route-target-group-ids rtg-xxxx --member-id ep-xxxx --max-results 50 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazdjdhd0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceJoshua --region cn-hangzhou
